item: H2 precursor -- choice-read stability on archived prefixes
why_not: the generation half needs the e2a session runner, which lives only in the gitignored clone; porting it is a rule-26 acceptance event and reimplementing it would break e2a comparability
coverage_limit: only prism/slate of the roster of record appears in the archive
decides_nothing: Instrument characterisation. H2 PASS/FAIL is the design instance's, and the generation half is not in this artifact.
provenance_repair_2026-08-21: per_read.session_id was written as e2a's bare `session` counter, which RESTARTS per arm and is therefore not unique (50 prism/slate records carry 28 distinct ids). `session_key` = arm:session is added as the unambiguous grouping key; session_id is left exactly as the run wrote it. No number in this artifact changes: the ICC was computed by grouping over session RECORDS during the run, never by this string, and every read is deterministic (greedy, uncached), so a re-run would reproduce these values identically. The script is fixed for future runs.
